title: Gene Circuit & Cloning
blurb: The four-module CcaSR green-light circuit in Bacillus subtilis, the SubtiToolKit Level 1 and Level 2 assembly scheme, the shuttle vector and constitutive twins, transformation into the chassis, and the six cloning cycles with the failures that drove them.
blurb_zh: 枯草桿菌 (Bacillus subtilis) 中四個模組的綠光感應迴路 (CcaSR)、SubtiToolKit 的 Level 1 與 Level 2 組裝架構、穿梭載體 (shuttle vector) 與組成型對照構築、轉型進入宿主的過程，以及六個選殖循環和推動它們的失敗。

questions.q: Name the four transcription units of the circuit, what each one does, and which one is the only light-gated unit.
questions.q_zh: 請說出迴路的四個轉錄單元 (transcription unit)、各自的功能，以及哪一個是唯一受光控制的單元。
questions.answer: Unit 1 is PCB production, PtagC+RBS to ho1:pcyA to L3S2P21 in pSTK-1A-sfGFP, which makes the phycocyanobilin chromophore the photoreceptor needs. Unit 2 is light sensing, PliaG to RBS0 to ccaSm3 to B0015 in pSTK-1B-sfGFP. Unit 3 is the response regulator, Pveg to RBS0 to ccaR to B0015 in pSTK-1C-sfGFP. Unit 4 is the output, PcpcG2-veg to EEBD to RBS0 to csn:cargo to B0015 in pSTK-1D-sfGFP, and it is the only light-gated unit; units 1 to 3 sit on constitutive promoters on purpose, so that light stays the only input to the system.
questions.answer_zh: 單元 1 是 PCB 生產，PtagC+RBS 接 ho1:pcyA 接 L3S2P21，位於 pSTK-1A-sfGFP，負責製造光受體所需的藻藍膽素 (phycocyanobilin) 發色團。單元 2 是光感應，PliaG 接 RBS0 接 ccaSm3 接 B0015，位於 pSTK-1B-sfGFP。單元 3 是反應調節蛋白 (response regulator)，Pveg 接 RBS0 接 ccaR 接 B0015，位於 pSTK-1C-sfGFP。單元 4 是輸出，PcpcG2-veg 接 EEBD 接 RBS0 接 csn:貨物基因 接 B0015，位於 pSTK-1D-sfGFP，而且是唯一受光控制的單元；單元 1 到 3 刻意使用組成型啟動子 (constitutive promoter)，讓光維持為系統唯一的輸入。
questions.trap: Saying the light-sensing unit is the light-controlled one; CcaS is expressed constitutively and only PcpcG2-veg is gated.
questions.trap_zh: 把光感應單元說成是受光控制的單元；CcaS 是組成型表達，只有 PcpcG2-veg 受光調控。

questions.q: You started in MoClo 2.0 and ended in the SubtiToolKit. What evidence made you move, and how much of that decision was yours?
questions.q_zh: 你們從 MoClo 2.0 開始，最後改用 SubtiToolKit。是什麼證據促使你們改變，而這個決定有多少是你們自己做的？
questions.answer: The MoClo 2.0 attempt went from unverified PCR product straight into the Level 1 destination vector pJUMP-29 with no verified Level 0 stage, and the screen came back with high background: empty vectors and off-target bands, with Golden Gate efficiency low throughout, so a failed assembly and a PCR artefact looked the same. Half the fix came from outside the team: a professor connected to the original CcaSR paper supplied the SubtiToolKit, and our Engineering page records that as luck rather than planning. We did not run a comparison between the two kits. The MoClo constructs were kept and became the templates the STK-compatible parts were amplified off.
questions.answer_zh: MoClo 2.0 的嘗試是把未經確認的 PCR 產物直接送進 Level 1 目標載體 pJUMP-29，中間沒有經過確認的 Level 0 階段，篩選結果背景很高：空載體與非目標條帶，Golden Gate 效率全程偏低，使得組裝失敗與 PCR 假產物看起來一樣。修正的一半來自團隊外部：一位與原始 CcaSR 論文有關的教授提供了 SubtiToolKit，而我們的 Engineering 頁面把這記錄為運氣而非規劃。我們並沒有真的比較過兩套套件。MoClo 的構築被保留下來，成為擴增 STK 相容部件所用的模板。
questions.trap: Presenting the kit swap as the outcome of a planned head-to-head comparison; the page says the kit arrived by luck.
questions.trap_zh: 把換套件說成是規劃好的並列比較結果；頁面寫的是套件是運氣來的。

questions.q: Show me the data where green light turns your circuit on.
questions.q_zh: 請給我看綠光把你們的迴路打開的數據。
questions.answer: We do not have it. Nothing anywhere in our records shows PcpcG2-veg output changing with green light: no induction curve, no dose response and no dark control series, and no dose, duration or intensity has ever been paired with an expression readout. Every statement we make about the switch is design intent carried from the two CcaSR papers, and our own pages say so at the top of Engineering, Parts and Results. The apparatus, DiOPAL, is built and the Level 2 strain exists, so the missing experiment is one green-against-dark dose series on the Level 2 strain with an expression readout; Results names it as the single experiment that would move the project furthest.
questions.answer_zh: 我們沒有。我們的記錄中沒有任何資料顯示 PcpcG2-veg 的輸出隨綠光改變：沒有誘導曲線、沒有劑量反應、沒有暗對照系列，也從未把任何光劑量、時間或強度和表達讀值配對。我們對這個開關的每一句話都是取自兩篇 CcaSR 論文的設計意圖，我們自己的 Engineering、Parts 與 Results 頁面在最上方就這樣寫。光照裝置 DiOPAL 已經做好，Level 2 菌株也存在，所以缺的實驗是在 Level 2 菌株上做一組綠光對暗的劑量系列並讀取表達量；Results 頁把它列為最能推進整個專案的單一實驗。
questions.trap: Offering the Math Model kinetics or the DiOPAL lux measurements as induction data; both are model output or lamp characterisation, not expression.
questions.trap_zh: 拿 Math Model 的動力學或 DiOPAL 的照度測量當誘導數據；那些是模型輸出或燈具特性，不是表達量。

questions.q: Your strongest cloning evidence is the 19 September nine-lane gel. State precisely what it proves and what it does not.
questions.q_zh: 你們最強的選殖證據是 9 月 19 日那張九道膠。請精確說明它證明了什麼、沒有證明什麼。
questions.answer: It shows three independent ACDI clones, X1, X3 and X9, amplified across all three internal junctions in one gel: junction A with L2 pcyA F against L2 CcaSm3 R at 375 bp, junction B with L2 CcaSm3 F against CcaR R at 632 bp, and junction C with CcaR F against Csn R at 661 bp, and every lane carries a band. That establishes that the four modules are adjacent in the right order in three separate clones. It says nothing about the sequence between the junctions: no Level 2 construct has been sequenced end to end and the Level 2 sequencing cell is blank for both devices, so nothing on our wiki should call the joined circuit verified. The modules were sequence-confirmed individually at Level 1, in a different plasmid.
questions.answer_zh: 它顯示三個獨立的 ACDI 菌落 X1、X3、X9，在同一張膠上跨三個內部接點擴增：接點 A 用 L2 pcyA F 對 L2 CcaSm3 R，375 bp；接點 B 用 L2 CcaSm3 F 對 CcaR R，632 bp；接點 C 用 CcaR F 對 Csn R，661 bp，每一道都有條帶。這證明四個模組在三個獨立菌落中以正確順序相鄰。它完全沒有說明接點之間的序列：沒有任何 Level 2 構築做過全長定序，兩個裝置的 Level 2 定序欄都是空白，所以我們的 wiki 上不該把接好的迴路稱為已驗證。各模組是在 Level 1、在另一個質體中各自定序確認的。
questions.trap: Calling the Level 2 device sequence-verified, or saying nine correct junctions mean the circuit carries no mutation.
questions.trap_zh: 把 Level 2 裝置稱為已定序驗證，或說九個正確接點代表迴路沒有突變。

questions.q: The paper you built from put ccaS under a xylose-inducible promoter. Why did you not do the same, and what did that cost you?
questions.q_zh: 你們依據的論文把 ccaS 放在木糖誘導型啟動子下。你們為什麼不照做，而這讓你們付出什麼代價？
questions.answer: Castillo-Hair and colleagues ran ccaS under the xylose-inducible PxylA and had to strip a 59 bp untranslated region, a truncated xylA reading frame and a premature stop codon out of it. We used constitutive promoters from the start, because the whole argument of ReLeaf is that light is the only input, and a sensor that has to be chemically induced before it can sense adds a second input to the system. The cost is that we cannot tune sensor level with an inducer, so we had to build the sensor at two fixed levels instead, PliaG and PlepA, and carry two Level 2 devices because we have no induction measurement to choose between them.
questions.answer_zh: Castillo-Hair 等人把 ccaS 放在木糖誘導型 PxylA 下，並且必須移除其中 59 bp 的非轉譯區、一段截斷的 xylA 讀框和一個提前的終止密碼子。我們一開始就使用組成型啟動子，因為 ReLeaf 的核心論點是光是唯一的輸入，而一個必須先被化學誘導才能感光的感測器會為系統加入第二個輸入。代價是我們無法用誘導物調整感測器的量，只能把感測器建在兩個固定的表現量上，PliaG 與 PlepA，並且因為沒有誘導量測可以在兩者之間取捨，而同時保留兩個 Level 2 裝置。
questions.trap: Claiming the constitutive choice was shown to work better; no expression comparison between the two designs was ever made.
questions.trap_zh: 聲稱組成型的選擇已被證明更好；兩種設計之間從未做過表達量比較。

questions.q: What was the marker clash found in cycle 4, when was it found, and how was it fixed?
questions.q_zh: 第 4 循環發現的抗生素標記衝突是什麼？何時發現？如何解決？
questions.answer: Both pGEM-T Easy, the intermediate that fixed cycle 2, and every Level 1 destination vector carry ampicillin. Carryover donor vector is normally selected away at the transformation step, and with a shared marker it is not, so background colonies survive selection. It was found after the fact, in August. The fix was to amplify the coding sequences with the full BpiI and BsaI tail and clone them directly into the kit's pSTK-0C entry vector, which puts chloramphenicol on the donor and ampicillin on the destination; three Level 0 screens on 14 August came back clean at their expected sizes and three clones from each went to liquid culture. Only the coding sequences not already cloned in cycle 3 were affected.
questions.answer_zh: 修好第 2 循環的中間載體 pGEM-T Easy 和每一個 Level 1 目標載體都帶有安比西林 (ampicillin) 抗性。帶過來的供給載體通常會在轉型步驟被篩選掉，但共用同一個標記時就不會，所以背景菌落能存活。這是事後、在八月發現的。解決方式是用完整的 BpiI 與 BsaI 尾端擴增編碼序列，直接選殖進套件自己的 pSTK-0C 入口載體，使供給端帶氯黴素 (chloramphenicol)、目標端帶安比西林；8 月 14 日的三個 Level 0 篩選都在預期大小處乾淨，每個各有三個菌落進入液體培養。只有第 3 循環尚未選殖的編碼序列受影響。
questions.trap: Saying the clash was predicted in advance; the page calls it a compatibility problem found after the fact.
questions.trap_zh: 說這個衝突事先就預期到了；頁面稱它是事後才發現的相容性問題。

questions.q: Why insert a pGEM-T Easy step before Golden Gate, when it adds a day and changes none of the genetics?
questions.q_zh: 既然多花一天又完全不改變遺傳設計，為什麼要在 Golden Gate 之前加入 pGEM-T Easy 這一步？
questions.answer: Because with a raw PCR product as the donor, a wrong band can be either a failed assembly or an artefact of the amplification, and four of our six cloning cycles are variations on that one problem. pGEM-T Easy pairs its 3-prime thymidine overhangs with the 3-prime adenosine a non-proofreading polymerase leaves, so each coding sequence could be cloned, screened by colony PCR between the flanking T7 and SP6 promoters, and sequence-confirmed before it ever met BsaI. Seven sets, A to G, were done this way, each with its own expected size, and the chromophore operon set F ran at 1,726 bp on 1 July. The cost was a day of picking, screening and minipreps; what it bought was the end of the cycle 2 ambiguity.
questions.answer_zh: 因為以未純化確認的 PCR 產物當供給 DNA 時，一個錯誤條帶可能是組裝失敗，也可能是擴增產生的假產物，而我們六個選殖循環中有四個都是這同一個問題的變形。pGEM-T Easy 以其 3 端胸腺嘌呤突出端配對非校讀聚合酶留下的 3 端腺嘌呤，所以每個編碼序列都能先被選殖、用兩側的 T7 與 SP6 啟動子做菌落 PCR 篩選，並在接觸 BsaI 之前完成定序確認。共有七組 A 到 G 以此方式完成，各有自己的預期大小，發色團操縱子 F 組在 7 月 1 日跑在 1,726 bp。代價是一天的挑菌、篩選與小量質體製備；換來的是第 2 循環那種模糊性的終結。
questions.trap: Adding that a confirming restriction digest was also run at this stage; the page says no digest was run, because band size plus full-length sequencing answered both questions.
questions.trap_zh: 補充說這一階段還做了確認性限制酶切；頁面說沒有做酵素切，因為條帶大小加全長定序已回答了兩個問題。

questions.q: Your own records describe the first screen of cycle 1 in three different ways. What are they, and what is missing from cycle 2?
questions.q_zh: 你們自己的記錄用三種不同方式描述第 1 循環的第一次篩選。那三種說法是什麼？第 2 循環又缺了什麼？
questions.answer: Three statements sit in the same file, Engineering_.docx of 21 September 2026: the DBTL 1 test field says transformant colonies were screened by colony PCR and gave inconsistent, low-efficiency cloning; the DBTL 2 design field says transformation did not reveal any colonies; and the light-sensing module says barely any colonies transformed. They cannot all be true of the same plates, and which one is depends on notebook pages we do not have. Cycle 2 is worse: the document goes straight from the build into cycle 3, so no gel and no conclusion exist for that attempt, and its design field opens on a lesson about insufficient expression from Pveg-RBS0 that cycle 1 never taught, at a point in the timeline where no expression measurement of any kind exists in our records.
questions.answer_zh: 三種說法都在同一份檔案 Engineering_.docx（2026 年 9 月 21 日）裡：DBTL 1 的 test 欄說轉型菌落做了菌落 PCR，結果是不一致且效率低的選殖；DBTL 2 的 design 欄說轉型沒有長出任何菌落；光感應模組那段說幾乎沒有菌落轉型成功。它們不可能同時為真，而哪一個才對取決於我們手上沒有的實驗記錄頁。第 2 循環更糟：文件從 build 直接跳到第 3 循環，所以那次嘗試沒有膠也沒有結論，而它的 design 欄一開頭就引用一個第 1 循環從未教過的教訓，說 Pveg-RBS0 表達不足，而在時間軸上的那個時點，我們的記錄裡根本沒有任何表達量測。
questions.trap: Reconciling the three statements on the spot; the page deliberately leaves it unresolved because the notebook pages are missing.
questions.trap_zh: 當場把三種說法圓回來；頁面刻意保留未解，因為實驗記錄頁遺失。

questions.q: Give the electroporation conditions you settled on for B. subtilis and the voltage window you measured.
questions.q_zh: 請說明你們為枯草桿菌確定的電穿孔條件，以及你們量到的電壓區間。
questions.answer: Cells were grown in LB with 0.5 M sorbitol to OD600 0.85 to 0.95, washed four times in ice-cold sorbitol and glycerol buffer and concentrated fortyfold. Pulses were delivered across a 0.2 cm gap at 25 microfarads. The first attempt arced at 2.0 and 1.8 kV with the resistance set to infinity and the time constant read zero; putting 300 ohms in parallel fixed it and gave a 6.7 ms time constant, and every later run used that setting. Colony yield rises from 2.0 to 2.3 kV and collapses by 2.5 kV, from 1,606 colonies to 37 inside the 23 May trial.
questions.answer_zh: 細胞在含 0.5 M 山梨醇 (sorbitol) 的 LB 中培養至 OD600 0.85 到 0.95，以冰冷的山梨醇甘油緩衝液洗四次，濃縮四十倍。脈衝在 0.2 公分間距的電極槽、25 微法拉下施加。第一次嘗試在 2.0 與 1.8 kV、電阻設為無限大時放電打火，時間常數讀到零；並聯 300 歐姆後解決，得到 6.7 毫秒的時間常數，之後每次都用這個設定。菌落產量從 2.0 kV 升到 2.3 kV，到 2.5 kV 就崩掉，在 5 月 23 日那一輪內從 1,606 個菌落降到 37 個。
questions.trap: Calling these transformation efficiencies; they are single plates per condition with no input count taken, so they are colony counts.
questions.trap_zh: 把這些稱為轉型效率；每個條件只有單一培養皿、也沒有記錄投入量，所以它們只是菌落數。

questions.q: Your cycle 5 record says the gel bands confirmed intact plasmid integration in B. subtilis. Can a colony PCR say that?
questions.q_zh: 你們第 5 循環的記錄說膠上的條帶確認了質體在枯草桿菌中完整整合。菌落 PCR 能這樣說嗎？
questions.answer: No, and our own page corrects it. A colony PCR band says a template of the right length is present in that colony. It does not say where the construct sits, whether it is intact outside the amplified stretch, or whether the plasmid is carried at all. Engineering marks this as a wording fix rather than a data fix: the bands are real and the sentence claims more than they can. There is a related gap on Parts: the archive nowhere records which cargo-bearing plasmid was in which transformant, so no individual part is marked as being in B. subtilis and the single 41 kDa band on the 24 August blot cannot be assigned to a named part either.
questions.answer_zh: 不能，我們自己的頁面也更正了這一點。菌落 PCR 的條帶只說明該菌落裡存在長度正確的模板。它沒有說構築位於何處、擴增區段以外是否完整，甚至沒有說質體是否真的被帶著。Engineering 把這標為措辭修正而非數據修正：條帶是真的，但那句話主張的超出條帶所能支持的範圍。Parts 頁上有一個相關缺口：檔案庫中沒有任何地方記錄哪一個帶貨物基因的質體在哪一個轉型株裡，所以沒有任何單一部件被標記為已進入枯草桿菌，8 月 24 日那張西方墨點 (Western blot) 上唯一的 41 kDa 條帶也無法歸屬到某個具名部件。
questions.trap: Defending the original sentence; the correct answer is to concede the overclaim and say what the band does establish.
questions.trap_zh: 替原句辯護；正確做法是承認過度主張，並說明條帶實際能確立什麼。

questions.q: Before the kit arrived you built your own Golden Gate shuttle vector. What happened to it?
questions.q_zh: 在套件到來之前，你們自己做了一個 Golden Gate 穿梭載體。它後來怎麼了？
questions.answer: In April, before the kit arrived, we built our own Golden Gate shuttle vector by moving a dropout cassette into pNW33N. The kit's own library sheet then described pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP as pNW33N adapted for STK, which is the same idea already done. Our page records it as the instinct being right and the work turning out redundant. All five constitutive constructs were built in pSTK-EXP1-sfGFP instead, because that plasmid replicates in both E. coli and B. subtilis so the same construct can be screened for expression in E. coli and carried into B. subtilis unchanged.
questions.answer_zh: 四月、在套件到來之前，我們把一段 dropout 卡匣移進 pNW33N，自製了一個 Golden Gate 穿梭載體。後來套件自己的部件清單把 pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP 描述為「pNW33N 改作 STK 用」，也就是同樣的想法早已有人做過。我們的頁面記為：直覺是對的，但這份工作最後是多餘的。五個組成型構築改為全部建在 pSTK-EXP1-sfGFP 上，因為那個質體能在大腸桿菌 (E. coli) 與枯草桿菌兩者中複製，所以同一個構築可以先在大腸桿菌篩選表達，再原封不動帶進枯草桿菌。
questions.trap: Presenting the home-made vector as part of the final build; it was superseded by the kit's own shuttle vector.
questions.trap_zh: 把自製載體說成最終構築的一部分；它已被套件自己的穿梭載體取代。

questions.q: Which chassis is this project built in? Your pages do not agree.
questions.q_zh: 這個專案的宿主菌株到底是哪一株？你們的頁面並不一致。
questions.answer: Every cloning, transformation and protein number behind the circuit is B. subtilis 168, and both Engineering and Results say so: Engineering states that the plan calls for comparing WB800N with strain 168 and that comparison has never been run, and the Results ledger closes the item with every number on this wiki is strain 168. That ledger line is now out of date on our own site: the homepage names the chassis as B. subtilis WB800N, Biomanufacturing says work to 19 September is strain 168 and the production strain is WB800N while showing a 19 September six-arm growth fit labelled WB800N, and Digital Twin says the registered forecast run is WB800N. The strain is also written both WB800 and WB800N. The rationale is recorded, on Milestone: on 6 August we left NCHU with a plate of B. subtilis WB800, a protease-deficient strain for secretion, from Professor Huang. What does not exist is any side-by-side 168 against WB800N measurement.
questions.answer_zh: 迴路背後的每一個選殖、轉型與蛋白數據都是枯草桿菌 168 株，Engineering 與 Results 都這樣寫：Engineering 說計畫要比較 WB800N 與 168 株，而那個比較從未執行；Results 的清單以「本 wiki 上的每個數字都是 168 株」結案。那一行在我們自己的網站上現在已經過時：首頁把宿主寫成 B. subtilis WB800N，Biomanufacturing 說 9 月 19 日之前的工作是 168 株、生產菌株是 WB800N，同時放了一張標為 WB800N 的 9 月 19 日六組光照條件的生長擬合，Digital Twin 也說預先登錄的預測實驗用的是 WB800N。菌株名稱也同時寫成 WB800 與 WB800N。選用理由是有記錄的，在 Milestone：8 月 6 日我們從中興大學帶回黃教授給的一盤 B. subtilis WB800，一株適合分泌的蛋白酶缺陷菌株。真正不存在的是任何 168 對 WB800N 的並列量測。
questions.trap: Answering WB800N flatly because the homepage says so; all circuit and blot data are strain 168.
questions.trap_zh: 因為首頁這樣寫就直接回答 WB800N；所有迴路與墨點數據都是 168 株。

questions.q: Why did you build a constitutive twin of every light-gated cargo, and what did that buy you?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼每一個受光控制的貨物構築都另外做了一個組成型的對照？這帶來什麼好處？
questions.answer: Because testing a protectant and an untested light switch at the same time means a negative result explains nothing: the failure could be the switch or the cargo. Every cargo built behind PcpcG2-veg in module 4 was also built behind constitutive Pveg with the same EEBD-RBS0 and B0015 in pSTK-EXP1-sfGFP, holding all four other elements constant so the cargoes stay comparable. Because of that twin, the protein work, the 53-hour reactor run and the plant sprays could all start before the switch existed, and every ACC deaminase result on the wiki comes from the constitutive cassette, module J. It is the decision Engineering lists first under what we learned across cycles.
questions.answer_zh: 因為同時測試一個保護劑和一個尚未驗證的光開關，會讓陰性結果什麼都解釋不了：失敗可能來自開關，也可能來自貨物基因。模組 4 中建在 PcpcG2-veg 後面的每個貨物，也都在 pSTK-EXP1-sfGFP 中建在組成型 Pveg 後面，搭配同樣的 EEBD-RBS0 與 B0015，其他四個元件全部固定，讓各貨物之間可比較。因為有這個對照，蛋白工作、53 小時的反應器運轉 和植物噴灑都能在開關存在之前開始，而 wiki 上每一個 ACC 去胺酶 (ACC deaminase) 結果都來自組成型卡匣，也就是組裝 J。這是 Engineering 在「跨循環所學」中列在第一條的決定。
questions.trap: Describing the constitutive twin as a positive control for the switch; it removes the switch from the question, it does not test it.
questions.trap_zh: 把組成型對照說成光開關的陽性對照；它是把開關從問題中移除，而不是測試開關。

questions.q: Level 2 failed three times with no design change. What did you change, and what did it give you?
questions.q_zh: Level 2 在沒有改設計的情況下連續失敗三次。你們改了什麼？得到什麼結果？
questions.answer: Three consecutive Golden Gate rounds returned nothing with no design change between them. On 28 August the insert-to-vector ratio was swept, at 1:5 and 1:7, and both returned positives; the protocol runs 20 microlitre reactions with 10 femtomoles of vector and 20 femtomoles of insert and ratios from 1:1 up to 1:7. On 1 September one clone from each ratio was checked across all three internal junctions at once, at 375, 632 and 661 bp, and those two clones are X5 and X7, named after the ratios that produced them. The fix was stoichiometry, not design.
questions.answer_zh: 連續三輪 Golden Gate 在設計完全未改的情況下什麼都沒長出來。8 月 28 日掃描了插入片段對載體的比例，試 1:5 與 1:7，兩者都出現陽性；該流程是 20 微升反應、10 飛莫耳載體與 20 飛莫耳插入片段，比例從 1:1 到 1:7。9 月 1 日各比例取一個菌落，一次跨全部三個內部接點檢查，分別在 375、632 與 661 bp，這兩個菌落是 X5 與 X7，依產生它們的比例命名。真正的修正是化學計量，不是設計。
questions.trap: Crediting a redesign for the Level 2 success; the only change was the insert-to-vector ratio.
questions.trap_zh: 把 Level 2 的成功歸功於重新設計；唯一的改變是插入片段對載體的比例。

questions.q: You rebuilt module 1 because Pveg and RBS0 gave no expression. How far does that conclusion actually reach?
questions.q_zh: 你們因為 Pveg 與 RBS0 沒有表達而重建模組 1。這個結論實際上能推到多遠？
questions.answer: Not as far as the heading suggests, and our own page flags why. The source sentence behind the finding is sequencing results showed that our request had no signal, which reads as a failed sequencing reaction rather than an expression result, and those are different failures with different remedies, only one of which is a reason to change a promoter. The cloning-progress table adds that the first round gave no successful clone and that promoter strength stays pending because the first version was never obtained. What we can say is that the source paper runs this unit on PrpsD and the MF001 ribosome binding site, that we had substituted the stronger Pveg and RBS0 to push chromophore supply up, and that the rebuild on PtagC+RBS and L3S2P21 is the version that screened at 1,833 bp on 30 July and sequenced positive on A1, A2 and A3.
questions.answer_zh: 沒有標題暗示的那麼遠，我們自己的頁面也標出了原因。這個發現背後的原始句子是「定序結果顯示我們的委託沒有訊號」，讀起來像是定序反應失敗而不是表達結果，而這兩者是不同的失敗、需要不同的補救，其中只有一種才構成更換啟動子的理由。選殖進度表又補充說第一輪沒有成功的菌落，而且因為第一版從未取得，啟動子強度的比較仍然待辦。我們能說的是：原始論文這個單元用的是 PrpsD 與 MF001 核醣體結合位，我們當初替換成較強的 Pveg 與 RBS0 以提高發色團供應，而以 PtagC+RBS 與 L3S2P21 重建的版本在 7 月 30 日篩到 1,833 bp，A1、A2、A3 都定序為正確。
questions.trap: Stating as fact that Pveg plus RBS0 expresses the chromophore operon poorly; no expression measurement of the first build exists.
questions.trap_zh: 把「Pveg 加 RBS0 表達發色團操縱子不佳」當成事實陳述；第一版構築並沒有任何表達量測。

questions.q: Cycle 6 was meant to diversify the repeated regulatory parts across all four modules. Why did only one module change?
questions.q_zh: 第 6 循環原本要把四個模組重複的調控元件都分散掉。為什麼最後只有一個模組改了？
questions.answer: The motive came from cycle 4: several modules share Pveg, RBS0 and B0015, and B. subtilis recombines homologous sequence readily, so once all four modules sat in one cell long identical stretches could give recombination something to act on. In cycle 6 module 1 took the change, onto PtagC+RBS and the L3S2P21 terminator with the same coding sequence; module 3 kept everything it had and so became the module the others were diversified away from; and module 4's terminator was swapped to a cold double terminator and then put back to B0015. Half the motive was then retired by asking somebody who knew: Professor Huang's view was that recombination in Bacillus is not the problem we thought. We never ran a recombination assay, and our records now carry recombination as both the reason and not the reason, with the date and substance of that advice missing.
questions.answer_zh: 動機來自第 4 循環：有幾個模組共用 Pveg、RBS0 與 B0015，而枯草桿菌很容易對同源序列進行重組，所以一旦四個模組同處一個細胞，長段相同序列就可能成為重組的對象。第 6 循環中只有模組 1 做了改動，換成 PtagC+RBS 與 L3S2P21 終止子，編碼序列不變；模組 3 完全保持原狀，因而成為其他模組「分散開來」的參照；模組 4 的終止子換成 cold 雙終止子後又換回 B0015。動機的一半隨後因為去問懂的人而退場：黃教授認為枯草桿菌的重組不是我們以為的問題。我們從未做過重組實驗，而我們的記錄現在同時把重組寫成理由與非理由，且缺少那段建議的日期與內容。
questions.trap: Saying the recombination risk was tested and ruled out; it was retired by expert opinion with no experiment and no date on record.
questions.trap_zh: 說重組風險已被實驗測試並排除；它是靠專家意見退場的，沒有實驗、記錄上也沒有日期。

questions.q: Every part you added to the kit carries the same primer tail. What is in it, and which enzyme does what?
questions.q_zh: 你們加進套件的每個部件都帶同一段引子尾。那段尾包含什麼？各酵素分別負責什麼？
questions.answer: Four elements: a 5-prime ATATAT spacer so the restriction enzyme has something to bind near the end of a linear fragment, the BpiI site GAAGAC, the BsaI site GGTCTC, and a part-specific annealing region at the start codon or the 3-prime end of the coding sequence. The tail is 29 bp and identical on all six circuit primers; thirteen primers is the whole set, and nine parts had to be turned into Level 0 entries because the kit does not ship ho1:pcyA, ccaSm3, ccaR, the secretion peptides or any of the protectants. BpiI is used only for Level 0 entry into pSTK-0, in place of an sfGFP dropout cassette, which is why a white colony on a blue plate is the first thing we look at; BsaI is used only at Level 1; and BpiI again joins four Level 1 modules into one Level 2 plasmid. Our SnapGene maps label the same site BbsI, because BpiI, BbsI and BpuAI are isoschizomers.
questions.answer_zh: 四個元件：5 端的 ATATAT 間隔序列，讓限制酶在線性片段末端附近有可結合處；BpiI 位點 GAAGAC；BsaI 位點 GGTCTC；以及部件專屬的黏合區，落在起始密碼子或編碼序列的 3 端。這段尾長 29 bp，在六條迴路引子上完全相同；整組共十三條引子，而因為套件並不提供 ho1:pcyA、ccaSm3、ccaR、分泌訊號肽或任何保護劑，有九個部件必須自行做成 Level 0 入口部件。BpiI 只用於 Level 0 進入 pSTK-0，取代其中的 sfGFP dropout 卡匣，這也是為什麼我們首先看的是藍色培養皿上的白色菌落；BsaI 只用於 Level 1；而 BpiI 再次把四個 Level 1 模組接成一個 Level 2 質體。我們的 SnapGene 圖把同一個位點標為 BbsI，因為 BpiI、BbsI 與 BpuAI 是同切酶 (isoschizomer)。
questions.trap: Saying BsaI does the Level 2 join; Level 2 is BpiI again, and BsaI is Level 1 only.
questions.trap_zh: 說 Level 2 的接合用 BsaI；Level 2 用的是 BpiI，BsaI 只用在 Level 1。

questions.q: A judge reads that you sprayed engineered B. subtilis on plants. What does your own Western blot say about that material?
questions.q_zh: 評審看到你們把工程化的枯草桿菌噴在植物上。你們自己的西方墨點對那批材料說了什麼？
questions.answer: It says the material carried no detectable ACC deaminase. The 24 August batch check carries exactly one band, sharp and saturated at roughly 41 kDa, and it is in the lane loaded with the 18 August culture; the lane loaded with the 23 August culture, which is the material that was sprayed, is blank. Our own minute of 26 August states it plainly. So the sprays of that week were not a protectant treatment, and the plant pretest that used them also failed on plate contamination, so it cannot be used as evidence in either direction. The gate we wrote afterwards, blot every batch before it touches a plant, has been stated and not yet applied, and even the positive lane has an air bubble above the band.
questions.answer_zh: 它說那批材料檢測不到 ACC 去胺酶。8 月 24 日的批次檢查只有一條帶，約 41 kDa、銳利且過曝，位在裝 8 月 18 日培養液的那一道；裝 8 月 23 日培養液、也就是實際被噴出去的材料的那一道是空白的。我們 8 月 26 日的會議記錄把這點寫得很清楚。所以那一週的噴灑並不是保護劑處理，而使用該批材料的植物前測也因培養皿污染失敗，因此它在任何方向上都不能當證據。我們事後寫下的規則「每批材料接觸植物前先做墨點」已經宣告但尚未執行，而且就連那條陽性帶上方也有一個氣泡。
questions.trap: Offering the 2 August fractionation blot as proof the sprayed batch contained protein; it is a different culture on a different day, and the 7 August blot names neither construct nor antibody.
questions.trap_zh: 拿 8 月 2 日的分離墨點當作噴出去那批含有蛋白的證明；那是不同日期的不同培養液，而 8 月 7 日那張墨點既沒寫構築也沒寫抗體。

questions.q: Why are there two versions of the light-sensing module, and two Level 2 devices?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼光感應模組有兩個版本，Level 2 也有兩個裝置？
questions.answer: Because the useful dynamic range of a two-component system depends on how much sensor is sitting in the cell, and we had no way to predict which level would work in our hands, so we built CcaS-m3 behind two constitutive promoters of different strength, PliaG and PlepA. Both were sequence-confirmed: assembly B on PliaG, clone B2, colony PCR 24 June and sequenced 3 July, and assembly C on PlepA, clones C6 and C9, colony PCR 22 July and sequenced 24 July. Because both survived, the Level 2 assembly was run twice: ACDI carries the PlepA photoreceptor and ABDI the PliaG one. Until an induction curve exists there is no way to choose between them, so we carried both, and ABDI is the weaker record because its junctions have never been checked all three at once in one gel.
questions.answer_zh: 因為雙組分系統的有用動態範圍取決於細胞內感測器的量，而我們無法預測哪一個表現量在我們手上可行，所以我們把 CcaS-m3 建在兩個強度不同的組成型啟動子後面，PliaG 與 PlepA。兩者都經定序確認：組裝 B 用 PliaG，菌落 B2，6 月 24 日菌落 PCR、7 月 3 日定序；組裝 C 用 PlepA，菌落 C6 與 C9，7 月 22 日菌落 PCR、7 月 24 日定序。因為兩者都成立，Level 2 組裝做了兩次：ACDI 帶 PlepA 版光受體，ABDI 帶 PliaG 版。在誘導曲線出現之前無法在兩者之間選擇，所以兩個都保留，而 ABDI 的記錄較弱，因為它的三個接點從未在同一張膠上一次檢查完。
questions.trap: Claiming one promoter was chosen as better; the comparison needs an induction measurement and there is not one.
questions.trap_zh: 聲稱已經選定其中一個啟動子較好；這個比較需要誘導量測，而我們沒有。

questions.q: What exactly does your evidence for the Csn secretion tag support, and where does it stop?
questions.q_zh: 你們對 Csn 分泌標籤的證據究竟支持到什麼程度，又在哪裡停住？
questions.answer: One blot, on 2 August, fractionated B. subtilis carrying the constitutive ACC deaminase construct into total pellet, soluble pellet and two supernatant lanes; the bands sit in the supernatant at around 35 to 40 kDa and both pellet lanes are effectively blank. That is the only fractionation evidence in the whole archive that the Csn tag does what it was chosen to do, and the whole reactor design assumes it. Its limits are on the page: it is one blot, no loading control, no molecular weight called on the original, and the two supernatant lanes are both labelled S with nothing on record to say what separates them. It supports export from the cell in a shake flask; it does not establish that protein crossed the hollow-fibre membrane, because the reactor time course is read two opposite ways in our own documents.
questions.answer_zh: 只有一張墨點，8 月 2 日，把帶組成型 ACC 去胺酶構築的枯草桿菌分成總沉澱、可溶沉澱與兩道上清液；條帶落在上清液約 35 到 40 kDa，兩道沉澱基本空白。那是整個檔案庫中唯一支持 Csn 標籤達成所選目的的分離證據，而整個反應器設計都以它為前提。它的限制就寫在頁面上：單一墨點、沒有上樣對照、原始影像沒有標分子量，而兩道上清液都標為 S，記錄中也沒有說兩者差異何在。它支持的是在搖瓶中蛋白離開細胞；它並未確立蛋白穿過中空纖維膜，因為反應器時序墨點在我們自己的文件中被讀成兩種相反的結果。
questions.trap: Treating the 2 August blot as evidence of membrane crossing; the shell side is a separate question and it is unsettled.
questions.trap_zh: 把 8 月 2 日的墨點當成穿膜的證據；殼側是另一個問題，而且尚未定論。

questions.q: You built the AmilCP chromoprotein behind both the light gate and a constitutive promoter. Why was it never used to read the switch?
questions.q_zh: 你們把 AmilCP 顯色蛋白同時建在光開關後面與組成型啟動子後面。為什麼從來沒用它來讀這個開關？
questions.answer: We cannot say why from the record. The chromoprotein was chosen because it is visible on a plate with no substrate and no cofactor, and it is among the best-evidenced constructs we have: assembly E, the gated version, clone G3, and assembly F, the constitutive version, clone H10, both colony-screened in late June and sequenced on 3 July, plus assembly K, SamyQ-TAT-HA-AmilCP, clones D10 and D14, sequenced 14 July. The 16 July panel even screens the gated and constitutive versions side by side. But no green-against-dark readout was ever taken on them, and the 23 September parts draft drops all three cassettes from the collection, which our own fix P8 flags as leaving a module called secretion reporter with no reporter in it. P8 asks for them to be restored with their build evidence or for the retirement to be explained in one line.
questions.answer_zh: 從記錄上我們說不出原因。選顯色蛋白是因為它在培養皿上不需底物、不需輔因子就看得見，而且它是我們證據最充分的構築之一：組裝 E 為受光控制版、菌落 G3，組裝 F 為組成型版、菌落 H10，兩者都在六月底完成菌落篩選、7 月 3 日定序；另有組裝 K、SamyQ-TAT-HA-AmilCP、菌落 D10 與 D14，7 月 14 日定序。7 月 16 日那組圖甚至把受光版與組成型版並列篩選。但從未在它們身上取過綠光對暗的讀值，而 9 月 23 日的 parts 草稿把這三個卡匣全部從收藏中刪掉，我們自己的修正項 P8 指出這會讓一個叫「分泌報告子」的模組裡沒有任何報告子。P8 要求把它們連同建構證據放回，或用一行說明為什麼放棄這條路。
questions.trap: Claiming the chromoprotein was tried under light and gave nothing; no light experiment was run on any construct.
questions.trap_zh: 聲稱顯色蛋白在光照下試過但沒有結果；沒有任何構築做過光照實驗。

questions.q: Three Level 1 assemblies are marked unsuccessful and also appear as positives. Which ones, and which matters most?
questions.q_zh: 有三個 Level 1 組裝被標為失敗，同時又出現在陽性記錄中。是哪三個？哪一個最關鍵？
questions.answer: G, L and M. The sequencing record, sequencing positive clone.docx, writes unsuccessful against all three and leaves their clone numbers blank; the Level 1 sheet gives G, H and L the status Assembly, meaning under way; and the gels show G7 to G9 going into liquid culture on 4 August and G4 and G6 on 10 August, L1 and L3 at 1.3 kb on 18 August, twenty-four L clones at 3,535 bp on 5 September and M9 at 2,837 bp on 9 September. The newest evidence is the most positive and none of the three records carries a date stamp saying when it was last true. G matters most: it is the light-gated LEA unit, and whether it exists changes what the collection can claim. The same spreadsheet is also the one whose Level 2 sheet holds one unrelated Not started row with neither ACDI nor ABDI anywhere in the workbook, and it is where our assembly lengths come from.
questions.answer_zh: G、L 與 M。定序記錄 sequencing positive clone.docx 對三者都寫「失敗」並留空菌落編號；Level 1 工作表把 G、H、L 的狀態寫成 Assembly，意即進行中；而膠片顯示 G7 到 G9 在 8 月 4 日、G4 與 G6 在 8 月 10 日進入液體培養，L1 與 L3 在 8 月 18 日跑在 1.3 kb，二十四個 L 菌落在 9 月 5 日跑在 3,535 bp，M9 在 9 月 9 日跑在 2,837 bp。最新的證據是最正面的，而三份記錄都沒有標註它最後一次為真的日期。其中 G 最關鍵：它是受光控制的 LEA 單元，它是否存在會改變這套部件收藏能主張的範圍。同一份試算表的 Level 2 工作表也只有一列無關的「未開始」，ACDI 與 ABDI 在整個檔案中都找不到，而我們的組裝長度正是取自該檔。
questions.trap: Declaring G successful because the newest gel is positive; the page refuses to settle it and says whoever picked those colonies has to say what happened.
questions.trap_zh: 因為最新的膠是陽性就宣布 G 成功；頁面拒絕下定論，並說該由挑那些菌落的人說明後續。

questions.q: Which promoter drives CcaR, and what is its Registry accession?
questions.q_zh: 驅動 CcaR 的是哪個啟動子？它的 Registry 編號是什麼？
questions.answer: Pveg, a constitutive B. subtilis promoter, with RBS0 and B0015, as assembly D at 3,243 bp, colony PCR 26 June and sequenced 1 July; it was the first module in the collection to be finished and the only one never rebuilt. The accession is in dispute and we should say so: Parts_.docx gives BBa_K143012, while the build record names the kit entry STK028_pSTK-0A-Pveg with accession BBa_K823003 and notes that we used the medium-expression Pveg, which differs in four nucleotides from the strong version. That is open fix P1, and it matters because those four nucleotides are the difference between a medium and a strong promoter, and Pveg drives CcaR in module 3 and the whole cargo in the shuttle build.
questions.answer_zh: 是 Pveg，一個枯草桿菌的組成型啟動子，搭配 RBS0 與 B0015，為組裝 D、3,243 bp，6 月 26 日菌落 PCR、7 月 1 日定序；它是這套收藏中最先完成、也是唯一從未重建的模組。編號有爭議，我們應該直說：Parts_.docx 寫 BBa_K143012，而建構記錄把套件條目寫為 STK028_pSTK-0A-Pveg、編號 BBa_K823003，並註明我們用的是中度表現的 Pveg，與強版相差四個核苷酸。那是未解項 P1，之所以重要是因為那四個核苷酸就是中強度與強啟動子的差別，而 Pveg 既驅動模組 3 的 CcaR，也驅動穿梭構築中的整個貨物基因。
questions.trap: Quoting one accession with confidence; also worth knowing that P2 records the SamyQ secretion tag as having no entry in the kit, where the nearest part is AmyQ.
questions.trap_zh: 自信地只報一個編號；另外值得知道 P2 記錄 SamyQ 分泌標籤在套件中找不到條目，最接近的部件是 AmyQ。

questions.q: What is the EEBD element for, and what is unresolved about it?
questions.q_zh: EEBD 元件的用途是什麼？關於它還有什麼未解決？
questions.answer: It is an E. coli expression blocking device, kit entry STK207: a B0015 terminator between two recombination sites with the ribosome binding site behind it, which keeps the cargo silent while the plasmid is being built in E. coli and recombines out in B. subtilis. It matters more in the constitutive module than in the light-gated one, because a constitutive promoter would otherwise express the cargo throughout the E. coli cloning. It is ordered and amplified as one part, so it reads as a single box on our construct maps even though the sequenced map resolves it into its pieces. Two things are unresolved: our files disagree on whether assembly I carries EEBD-MF001 or EEBD-RBS0, which is open fix P5 and is settled by opening the I3 or I6 read, and the RiboJ and EEBD parts have no citation anywhere in our records.
questions.answer_zh: 它是大腸桿菌表達阻斷裝置 (E. coli expression blocking device)，套件條目 STK207：兩個重組位點之間夾一個 B0015 終止子，後面接核醣體結合位，讓貨物基因在質體於大腸桿菌中建構期間保持靜默，並在枯草桿菌中重組移除。它在組成型模組中比在受光模組中更重要，因為組成型啟動子否則會在整個大腸桿菌選殖期間表達貨物基因。它是以單一部件訂購與擴增，所以在我們的構築圖上讀起來是一個方塊，儘管定序後的圖會把它解析成各個元件。有兩件事未解：我們的檔案對組裝 I 帶的是 EEBD-MF001 還是 EEBD-RBS0 看法不同，那是未解項 P5，只要打開 I3 或 I6 的定序結果就能解決；另外 RiboJ 與 EEBD 兩個部件在我們的記錄中完全沒有引用來源。
questions.trap: Saying EEBD is a ribosome binding site; the RBS sits behind it and the blocking device is the terminator between the two recombination sites.
questions.trap_zh: 把 EEBD 說成核醣體結合位；RBS 在它後面，阻斷裝置是夾在兩個重組位點之間的終止子。

questions.q: Parts of this section of the wiki are unwritten. Which parts, and who owns each gap?
questions.q_zh: wiki 的這個部分有些段落還沒寫。是哪些段落，各由誰負責？
questions.answer: Engineering lists them with owners. Chloe owes the test and learn steps of cycle 2, the second divergence of module 2 from Castillo-Hair et al. and whether that module's ribosome binding site is RBS0 or sRBS2 and MF002, and module 3's build sentence and learn field, both of which stop mid-sentence. Sophie C owes module 4, where four constructs are described and three are listed, and module 1's expected Level 0 amplicon size, which is still marked add the band size. Olivia and Sophia owe the wet lab side of protectant design and the BoPep4 reverse primer sequence, which has its BpiI and BsaI overhangs recorded and no sequence. By contrast the bioreactor and photometer cycle series carry no named owner at all, and their blank build and test headings are listed only against Hardware. Parts is a draft with seventeen open fixes and Results with ten.
questions.answer_zh: Engineering 把它們連同負責人一起列出。Chloe 負責第 2 循環的 test 與 learn 步驟、模組 2 與 Castillo-Hair 等人的第二項差異、以及該模組的核醣體結合位究竟是 RBS0 還是 sRBS2 與 MF002，還有模組 3 的 build 句與 learn 欄，兩者都寫到一半就停住。Sophie C 負責模組 4，那裡描述了四個構築但只列出三個，以及模組 1 的 Level 0 預期擴增長度，目前仍標著「補上條帶大小」。Olivia 與 Sophia 負責保護劑設計的濕實驗端，以及 BoPep4 反向引子的序列，目前只記了 BpiI 與 BsaI 突出端而沒有序列。相對地，生物反應器與光度計的循環系列完全沒有具名負責人，它們空白的 build 與 test 標題只掛在 Hardware 名下。Parts 是一份有十七個未解項的草稿，Results 有十個。
questions.trap: Treating the gaps as cosmetic; two of them, the module 2 ribosome binding site and module 4's missing fourth construct, change what the parts collection says it contains.
questions.trap_zh: 把這些缺口當成只是版面問題；其中兩項，模組 2 的核醣體結合位與模組 4 缺少的第四個構築，會改變這套部件收藏聲稱包含什麼。
